independent_technical_reasoning: An upgrade is proven by the authenticated target artifact and complete transition to the new loaded modules, not by a few final log lines. A successful AGFHC pass validates behavior under load but cannot establish package transaction integrity. Conversely, a clean install does not prove loaded GPU health. Both layers are retained while the duplicate standalone row remains explicit.
